svg.text: Homelab: media server, apps, games, monitoring & off-site backups
Two ports open to the internet, both behind Caddy + CrowdSec or a whitelist. Everything else is LAN + Tailscale only. Problems reach my phone in ~3 min; data is copied off-site every night.
forwards 443/80 → Caddy, 25565 → Minecraft, nothing else · Pi-hole sends home devices straight to the NAS
reads Caddy + Jellyfin logs · bans IPs
Flow: Seerr → Sonarr / Radarr → Prowlarr → SABnzbd (or qBittorrent) → hardlinked into /data/media → Jellyfin · one /data dataset, no copies
subtitles · TRaSH profiles as code · stats
Vaultwarden · BookStack · Minecraft hourly/daily · Immich dumps
Storage databases on fast NVMe, their backups on the pool: every copy on different hardware
encrypted on the NAS · 7 daily / 4 weekly / 6 monthly · weekly verify
Beelink watches everything · scrapes + probes the NAS over Tailscale
scrapes exporters · blackbox probes every app · 12 rules
its own health · clean shutdown on power loss
shared over NUT · ~70 min on battery · both machines shut down cleanly
bucket + key created with Terraform · $1/day cap
